baseline.note: Reuse measured initial agent; default system prompt and behavior retained when adding policy dispatch. Cache/latency differences will be disclosed.

experiments.hypothesis: Dev hypothesis E1: deeper candidates and larger context may include evidence lost below top-3, at the cost of tokens, latency and distraction. Other agent policy unchanged.
Dev hypothesis E2: generic intent/evidence-scope check may correct definition-vs-measures confusion and unsupported generalization, without changing retrieval/context parameters.

selection_criteria: Existing benchmark manifest order: grounded mean, citation validity (0/0 is not perfect), correct abstention, context evidence, first-retrieval Evidence Hit@3 then Hit@1, latency, estimated cost, simplicity. Report original-query reference separately from model-transformed queries.
test_policy: Lock selection/config/code/benchmark checksums after all dev reviews and before baseline/selected test. No test tuning.
